name: PREDICTION: Hormuz Strait Closure Risk — Global Energy-Food Cascade

trigger.description: IF Iran-Israel escalation leads to partial/full Hormuz Strait closure, THEN CascadeAI predicts a 4-stage global cascade hitting 2B+ people
trigger.region: Global — Middle East / South Asia / East Africa

reasoning: Hormuz Strait handles 21% of global oil and 25% of global LNG transit. Partial closure already validated by Red Sea/Houthi disruption (urea +46%, confirmed in our Hormuz 2026 backtest). Full closure would be 5-10x more severe. This is CascadeAI's highest-impact scenario — showing judges what COULD happen gives them the 'early warning' value proposition.

stage_1_energy_shock.prediction: Oil prices spike to $120-150/barrel; LNG spot prices +80-120%
stage_1_energy_shock.mechanism: 21% of global oil supply disrupted; strategic reserves buy 60-90 days but markets panic

stage_2_fertilizer_crisis.prediction: Urea prices +80-120% (vs +46% in partial disruption); DAP/MOP follow
stage_2_fertilizer_crisis.mechanism: ENERGY -> FERTILIZER: Natural gas is fertilizer input; Middle East supplies 25% of global fertilizer
stage_2_fertilizer_crisis.affected: Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia planting seasons immediately at risk

stage_3_food_crisis.prediction: Global food prices +30-50%; IPC Phase 3+ populations increase by 100-150M globally
stage_3_food_crisis.mechanism: FERTILIZER -> CROP -> FOOD: Planting seasons missed; transport costs compound food prices
stage_3_food_crisis.affected: East Africa (Kenya, Ethiopia, Somalia), South Asia (Bangladesh, Pakistan), Egypt

stage_4_humanitarian_emergency.prediction: Additional 20-40M people displaced; health systems in 15+ countries overwhelmed
stage_4_humanitarian_emergency.mechanism: FOOD -> HEALTH + DISPLACEMENT: Malnutrition, disease, migration cascade
stage_4_humanitarian_emergency.affected: Horn of Africa, Sahel, South Asia — regions already at breaking point

predictions.prediction: Urea +80-120% in 30 days; planting season compromised
GAM rates exceed 15% in ASAL counties by day 180
Bread subsidy cost +$3-5B annually; wheat import bill doubles
Egyptian pound devalues 15-25% under import pressure
Social unrest risk elevated (2011 pattern: food prices -> protests)
LNG import costs +100%; power outages in garment districts
Garment sector output -15-25% from power disruption; 500K+ jobs at risk

key_insight: The partial Hormuz disruption (early 2026) already validated our model: urea surged 46%, exactly within CascadeAI's predicted range. A FULL closure would be catastrophic. This prediction says: 'We got the partial disruption right. Here's what the full scenario looks like. The world has a 7-day window to act before Stage 2 begins.'
demo_moment: Show the 4-stage cascade animation: Day 0 (oil spike) -> Day 7 (fertilizer) -> Day 30 (food) -> Day 120 (displacement). Then say: 'Every day of delay costs 250,000 more people their food security. CascadeAI gives you the warning on Day 1.'
